collection.title: Porsche 911 2011 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche 911 2011 Onwards (991) will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 23" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
